adr-map.layout_hint: a numbered timeline of decision cards grouped into 6 thematic clusters (infrastructure, UI, data, auth, policy, features); each card shows the ADR number badge, the chosen technology, and a short rationale tag; use a left-to-right or top-to-bottom flow with thin connecting lines linking related decisions (e.g. Cloudflare -> Next.js -> DB-less state).

gem-score.title: Gem Score算出ロジック
gem-score.subtitle: 被依存数とstarの残差で過小評価度を測る

sections.heading: 出力
items: 健全性フィルタで足切り済み

gem-score.layout_hint: a left-to-right pipeline: input signal boxes (star count from GitHub, dependent count from Ecosyste.ms, criticality_score from OpenSSF) feed into a formula box computing Gem Index = dependents percentile minus star percentile; the pipeline forks into two parallel outputs — Gem Index drives ranking order, criticality_score drives a health filter/cutoff — merging into a final ranked & filtered gem list.
